opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: up to £56,000 in year one, £28,000 in years two and three, plus up to £6,000 per annum research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers without a permanent UK academic post; must hold a doctorate; must have submitted doctoral thesis for viva by closing date; must hold a UK degree or UK academic position; not eligible if more than four years since viva without career break.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships to undertake a significant piece of publishable research; 3-year tenure; salary contribution up to £56k/yr first year, £28k/yr thereafter; research expenses up to £6k per year.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from a UK university post; must be UK resident for at least 26 weeks; must have an established research record.
opportunities.summary: Supports senior retired researchers to complete a research project; tenure 3–24 months; salary costs covered up to £24,000.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: up to £5 million per award (ten awards); scholarships up to £5 million total per award

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree awarding powers; consortium of up to two universities allowed; applications are made by institutions, not individuals.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to 30 doctoral scholarships in an interdisciplinary priority area, including funding for master+PhD routes, postdoctoral opportunities, cohort‑building and administrative costs.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (single or collaborative) with research degree awarding powers; consortiums encouraged; one application per institution as lead.
opportunities.summary: Supports establishment of research centres for outstanding original research; up to £10 m over up to 10 years; two‑stage process (outline then detailed).

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Salary costs covered; research expenses up to £6,000 per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Well‑established, distinguished researchers in humanities or social sciences; must be employed at an eligible UK university; previous holders ineligible.
opportunities.summary: Supports distinguished researchers to complete a piece of original research; duration 2–3 years; salary contribution and up to £6 k per year for research expenses.

opportunities.title: Philip Leverhulme Prizes
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers with international impact; must hold a permanent post or long‑term fellowship at a UK university; doctoral degree awarded no more than ten years before closing date (with possible career‑break extensions).
opportunities.summary: Prize to support outstanding early‑career researchers; £100 k available over 2–3 years for any research purpose.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers employed at a UK university with research degree awarding powers; must be resident in the UK; not open to independent scholars or PhD students.
opportunities.summary: Supports experienced researchers to complete a piece of research; tenure 3–24 months; up to £70 k total award.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with at least two years post‑PhD experience; must hold a permanent UK academic appointment or be nominated with a contract; must not have held a similar award or received >£100k grant.
opportunities.summary: Supports talented early‑career scholars to build a modest research team; 4–5 year award; up to £1 m for staff salaries and associated costs.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university staff (or eligible specialist arts institutions) to host an eminent overseas professor; host institution must have research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: Invites overseas senior professor to the UK for 3–12 months to share expertise; funding covers travel, maintenance, and related costs.
